menu.shortcutUnavailable: Shortcut unavailable. Change it in Settings.
settings.title: agenticnights Settings
settings.coverHint: A key or click restores the screen. Agent input does not restore it.
settings.awakeIdleHint: Starts immediately during scheduled hours. Continues while you work.
settings.footer: 1–1440 min. Same start and end time: all day.
settings.invalidIdleDelay: Idle delay: enter a whole number from 1 to 1440.
settings.invalidDuration: Timer: enter a whole number from 1 to 1440.
settings.shortcutHint: ⌘, ⌥ or ⌃ + A–Z, 0–9 or F1–F20. Esc cancels recording.
settings.shortcutInvalid: Use ⌘, ⌥ or ⌃ with A–Z, 0–9 or F1–F20.
settings.idleHint: Blackout follows the last physical input. Sleep prevention starts immediately.
privacy.enable: Require a password to restore the screen
privacy.settingsHint:
Blackout requires Accessibility permission. Password protection keeps the Mac awake until you unlock.
Password: 8–128 English letters, numbers, spaces or symbols. Blank fields keep the saved password.
privacy.passwordRules: Use 8–128 printable English letters, numbers, spaces or symbols.
privacy.noPassword: Set an unlock password before enabling password protection.
privacy.passwordUnavailable: The unlock password could not be read or saved in Keychain. Unlock your Keychain and try again.
privacy.title: Screen locked
privacy.unlockHint:
Password · Return to unlock
Escape to hide
privacy.systemLockFailed: macOS lock failed. Input remains blocked; try again to request macOS lock.
privacy.startFailed: Could not start blackout. Check display support and the saved password.
privacy.accessibility: Enable agenticnights in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility, then try again.
privacy.coverHint: A key or click opens the password prompt. App switching does not unlock.
privacy.systemLockRequired: Sign in to macOS to continue.
